title: MV OG Shin Megami Tensei-like 3d dungeon and mapping plugin (sample rgss scripts and pics added)

posts.author: Katzen
posts.body:
I’m new to forum and not good at English, so it could not be in right place.
I’m trying to make game with 3D dungeon and 2D map, just like Shin Megami Tensei in SNES or Etrian Odyssey. MV3D and FPLE can create 3D map, but those need extra block to put wall.
As this make dungeon larger than I planned, I’m looking for plugins.
What I needs are;
1. Create 3D dungeon, not using blocks to make walls or doors.
2. Mapping where player walked already in 3D dungeon.
3. Allows change 2D and 3D maps (2D field and 3D dungeon)
As I researched, some VX scripts did that. You can find how that works in videos about Shin Megami Tensei VX (some fun-ported variants with RPG maker VX).
I’m wondering if this is kind of porting scripts to plugin…
